continuation._doc: DGC-002 continuation manifest limits for chained subagent dispatches. mode: off|warn|enforce, missing/invalid -> warn.

context_pressure._doc: RC-7 live main-session context gate. ratio = last main-session assistant usage (input + cache_read + cache_creation) / model context window. mode: off = no-op; warn = never deny, report would_deny and bump would_deny:context_pressure; enforce = deny at ratio >= threshold. Missing/invalid mode -> warn. Unknown model window (default fallback) fails open.
